about: Gate 205 (browser) drives the Puzzles trainer at 320x568, 375x667 and kunal761 at text scales 1, 1.6 and 2.4 (gates/drive/textscale.js multiplies every text element's font-size and px line-height) and asserts the board is inside the viewport, above the tab bar, the same across two settles, and that #root has nothing to scroll, after proving the larger text moved the board. The breaks redden the no-scroll line at 320x568 at 2.4 only; the real code must pass everywhere. NOT COVERED: other screens, the other four of the drill seven, the job's control-row budget from gate 48, a real iOS Larger Text.

breaks.name: fit-loop-skips-puzzles
breaks.why: the fit loop no longer runs for the puzzle screens, so the board keeps its first size and the column overflows its box at the largest text

breaks.name: fit-loop-reads-no-overflow
breaks.why: the fit loop runs but reads zero overflow every pass, so it never trims
